title: Reveal Cards In Increasing Order
summary: Given an integer array representing a deck of cards, find an ordering of the deck so that when the cards are revealed one by one according to the specified steps, they are shown in increasing order.
statement: Given an integer array representing a deck of cards, find an ordering of the deck so that when the cards are revealed one by one according to the specified steps, they are shown in increasing order. The process starts by revealing the top card, then optionally moving the next top card to the bottom of the deck, and continues until all cards are revealed.
constraints: Repeatedly reveal the top card, then move the next top card to the bottom when present.
Return an initial ordering whose reveal sequence is increasing.
hints: Reverse the reveal process while consuming cards from greatest to smallest.
Before placing each earlier revealed card, undo the move-to-bottom by rotating the current bottom to the top.
Then place the next value at the top.
Each reverse step exactly inverts the forward reveal operation, yielding the unique required arrangement.
editorial: Each reverse step exactly inverts the forward reveal operation, yielding the unique required arrangement.

tests.explanation: Ordering one,1000 already reveals increasing values.
